text: The current look-and-feel and usability of remote controls are disliked by users and are hard to learn, with remotes often getting lost in rooms.
Open problem: it is unclear what the screen should do or what is required from it.

The target group will be sixteen to forty, and the product will have two groups of functions: simple for the broad public and advanced options for younger users, while preserving all classic remote functions and improving usability and the physical design.

The product will not include teletext or the newsflash feature; corporate identity with the logo present and colours consistent will be maintained, and the UI work will involve grouping functions into display and basic categories, compiling an LCD screen menu, integrating channel-changing functionality, and implementing a paged LCD menu.
